title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on community correlation, investment correlation, and conspiracy belief tasks adapted from cognitive psychology paradigms to measure illusory pattern perception (unsupported relational inference).
Prompting LLMs to adopt different gender personas (female and male) to measure the variance in their susceptibility to illusory pattern perception.
Prompting LLMs to adopt different age personas (child and elderly) to measure the variance in their susceptibility to illusory pattern perception.
Prompting LLMs to adopt different educational background personas (elementary school and college) to evaluate changes in their illusory pattern perception behavior.
Prompting LLMs to adopt different ethnic personas (African American and Asian) to assess changes in their susceptibility to illusory pattern perception.
